- Fried rice, ~163 kcal/100 g → ≈209 kcal
- Fresh tomato, ~25 kcal/100 g → ≈9 kcal
- Cooked bacon, ~540 kcal/100 g → ≈180 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About half of a dinner plate covered with three dense, substantial components (eggs, rice, bacon) gives roughly 290 g. That is plausible for the visible amount, and about 535 kcal fits a breakfast-style plate of this size.
